intake.client_name: Jasmine Cordero, a minor (parent: Ana Cordero)

contact.address: 2216 Alameda Court, Apt. 5, Encinal Springs, CA 93610

intake.matter_summary: Represent a 16-year-old in a Juvenile Division wardship petition (Welf. & Inst. Code § 602) alleging vandalism arising from an April 10, 2026 parking-lot incident at Encinal Ridge High School; evaluate an informal diversion offer against a contested jurisdictional hearing.
intake.referral_source: referral from a neighbor who is a former firm client

parties_checked: The People of the State of California (Alta Mesa County District Attorney)
conflicts_check.notes: No current or former firm client appears among the parties or witnesses. The firm does not and will not represent the separately charged co-participants, Kayla Trejo (represented by the public defender) or Andre Sotelo; noted to avoid any adverse-representation issue and the Rule 4.2 no-contact constraint as to Kayla.

time_entries.narrative: Initial intake interview with Jasmine and Ana Cordero; preliminary case assessment; conflicts screen.
Draft engagement letter; open matter file; calendar first appearance and key deadlines.
Review SRO incident report, surveillance/phone-video still-frame log, and prior dress-code referral; issue-spot vandalism participation and identification questions; note evidentiary gaps.
Interview student eyewitness (T. Villareal); memo to file on attribution of keying to co-participant.
Appear at first hearing in Juvenile Division; deny allegations on behalf of the minor; obtain scheduling order.
Obtain school disciplinary and attendance records; confer with school regarding character and dispositional supports.
Negotiation call with Deputy District Attorney regarding diversion terms and apportioned restitution given disputed role.
Client counseling session with Jasmine and Ana Cordero: diversion offer versus contested jurisdictional hearing; risks and priorities.
Draft strategic settlement-and-negotiation plan memo; outline restitution and responsibility-acknowledgment position.
Professional-responsibility analysis memo: Rule 4.2 as to represented co-participant; confidentiality and school-questioning issues.
